categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies shared utility class in `src/util/btcsignals.h` and adds tests in `src/test/btcsignals_tests.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Fixes a lifetime bug in `btcsignals` where disconnected callbacks remain alive indefinitely without subsequent `connect()` calls, preventing shutdown deadlocks for resources like `mp::EventLoopRef` and unblocking #10102.
